description: Turn any list of business websites into an outreach-ready contact list. Extracts the public contact details each business publishes: email addresses, phone numbers, and social media profiles (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok). Fast, reliable, no browser needed. Public business data only.
